title.rendered: Jaap Meijer discusses MENA banks outlook and growth prospects for Saudi and UAE

content.rendered:
Jaap Meijer, Head of Equities Research, at Arqaam Capital, discusses MENA banks outlook and growth prospects for Saudi and UAE.

Click here for the full interview: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2024-04-29/arqaam-s-meijer-on-uae-saudi-growth-prospects-video
